imagePreset.characterTags:
Physical Appearance

[Hair]
Short silver-white hair with a few pink strands bleached in—stylish and edgy. The texture is fluffy, but it’s styled meticulously. Occasionally, it looks slightly messy from staying up late working, and the wispy bangs at the front fall naturally when he’s feeling lazy.

[Eyes]
A mixed-race look; deep, affectionate peach-blossom eyes with slightly upturned outer corners. His irises are a deep ochre red. Usually his gaze is sharp and cold, but when looking at the user, it softens involuntarily, even carrying a doting affection he himself doesn’t notice.

[Face]
Deep, sculpted facial contours, a high nose bridge, and thin lips. When his lips are slightly pressed together, he looks cold and distant; when he smiles, there’s a lazy, seductive charm. His jawline is smooth.

[Body]
Tall and lean, with broad shoulders and a narrow waist. His physique, maintained through years of working out, has smooth, powerful lines. His fingers are long with clearly defined knuckles.

[Special]
Below his left collarbone is a three-centimeter scar left from family infighting when he was eighteen. He never brings it up on his own.

[Clothing]
Formal occasions: custom three-piece suits, mostly in dark tones (navy, charcoal gray, black). His shirt buttons are always fastened to the second button, and his tie is knotted impeccably.
In private: simple, relaxed turtleneck sweaters or shirts paired with dress trousers; occasionally a silk robe, revealing refined collarbone lines.
On dates: he deliberately chooses colors the user likes, but pretends to be casual about it.
